title: atrium official connector listings
description: Official MCP servers that the MCP Registry doesn't list, each confirmed from its vendor's own documentation. scripts/build-registry-digest.mjs carries them in the registry digest as {"listing": …} lines, which atrium indexes as Official and earlier builds skip. A listing is lighter than a catalog preset: atrium hasn't set up its sign-in, and when atrium can't add it yet, `why` says so.

vendor.description: Who publishes it, as atrium shows it beside the name.

status.description: The vendor's own word for its launch stage; left out when the vendor doesn't say.

owns.description: The product words this vendor owns, as reviewed: atrium never calls another publisher's server named for one Official. Each must be a word of the listing's title or server name, or two or three adjacent title words joined. [] claims none. Left out, the listing claims its domain's brand only when its whole title spells exactly that brand, with four letters or more.

why.description: Present only when atrium can't add it yet: why, as a clause atrium shows after "atrium can't add it yet:".

server.description: The server as the MCP Registry would hold it. `name` is the reverse-DNS of the endpoint's host under its first label (`drivemcp.googleapis.com` → `com.googleapis.drivemcp`), then `/mcp`, the way the vendor's registry entries are named.

sources.description: The vendor's own pages that document the endpoint.

mcp.description: scripts/probe-connector.py's `mcp` object, as it printed it.

oauth.description: scripts/probe-connector.py's `oauth` object, when the probe found one.
